slides.title: Aims for Using Walking Aids?
slides.english_text:
Aims for Using Walking Aids?
• Increase area of Base of support (BOS)
• Better BALANCE – maintain the centre of gravity (CG) over BOS
• Redistribute weight bearing area with decreased loading on injured part
• Improve proprioception
• Decrease pain
• Assist weak muscles
→ Improve stability and independency

slides.english_text:
Quadripod
• Good ability of individuals pretty good balance & stability
• ONLY for Full weight bearing (FWB)
• Place at GOOD/ UNAFFECTED side
• Easy to use for stairs walking & other confined areas
• Easy storage & usage
• Bigger base = more support
• Sequence:
• Modified 4pt: Quad → weak leg
→ good leg
• Modified 2pt: (Quad + weak leg)
→ good leg

➢ Bilateral crutches or walker
➢ Used in NWB only
➢ Good side: FWB; Affected NWB
➢ At least 50% of body weight is transmitted through the upper limb.
• UL strength, core stability & good lower limb must be assessed BEFORE attempting this gait pattern
➢ The energy cost is about TWICE as normal walking (more tiring)

• Sequence:

• A slower gait pattern, but a stable one.
